faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about apartment and house cleaning
faq.q1: How often would you recommend regular cleaning?
faq.a1: For a regular household, we recommend cleaning 1x per week or 2x per month. It depends on apartment size, number of residents and your preferences. We'll be happy to help you find the ideal frequency.
faq.q2: Do I need to be home during cleaning?
faq.a2: No, we offer key service. After signing a contract, we can clean even without your presence. We have liability insurance and all our workers are verified.
faq.q3: Do you provide your own cleaning supplies?
faq.a3: Yes, we bring our own eco-friendly cleaning supplies and professional equipment. However, we can also use your products if you prefer or have special requirements.
faq.q4: Do you clean on weekends too?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer cleaning 7 days a week including Saturdays and Sundays to accommodate your schedule. Weekend appointments are very popular, so we recommend booking in advance.
faq.q5: What if I need to change the appointment?
faq.a5: Just let us know at least 24 hours in advance and we'll arrange an alternative appointment without any fees. We understand that life brings unexpected situations.
faq.q6: Do you also offer deep cleaning?
faq.a6: Yes, we also perform extensive deep cleaning including window washing, stove cleaning, refrigerator, tiles and other more demanding work. We recommend deep cleaning 2-4x per year.
faq.moreQuestions: Have more questions? Don't hesitate to contact us!

excessiveDamage.question: What if a guest causes excessive damage?
excessiveDamage.answer: In such a case, we will immediately contact you with photo documentation and offer a solution. We charge according to the actual scope of work.

eveningWeekend.question: Can you clean in the evening or on weekends?
eveningWeekend.answer: Yes, we are available 7 days a week including evening hours. We understand that check-outs and check-ins are often at non-standard times.

reportIssues.question: Do you report minor issues too?
reportIssues.answer: Yes, we check the functionality of all equipment and immediately report any issues or missing equipment to you.

communication.question: How does communication and ordering work?

furniture.title: Furniture and Upholstery Cleaning
furniture.description: Professional wet and dry cleaning of upholstered furniture. Removal of stains, odors and allergens using state-of-the-art technology.
features: Fast drying thanks to modern technology

process.step1Desc: We check material type and stains

dryingTime.question: How long does drying take?
dryingTime.answer: Thanks to modern technology, furniture is only slightly damp and can be used after 2-4 hours. Complete drying takes 6-12 hours depending on the material.

oldStains.question: Can you remove old stains?
oldStains.answer: Most stains, yes. We have special products for wine, coffee, blood, grease, etc. For very old stains, we cannot guarantee 100% removal, but we always strive for maximum results.

safeForChildren.question: Is cleaning safe for children and pets?
safeForChildren.answer: Yes, we use eco-friendly, certified products that are safe for the whole family including children and animals.

leatherFurniture.question: Do you clean leather furniture too?
leatherFurniture.answer: Yes, we have special procedures and products for leather and faux leather. Cleaning including subsequent treatment and leather care.

protectionTreatment.question: What is protection treatment and what is it for?
protectionTreatment.answer: Protection treatment creates an invisible protective layer that repels liquids and dirt. It extends the life of furniture and makes regular maintenance easier.

preparation.question: Do I need to prepare the furniture in any way?
preparation.answer: Ideally remove loose items (pillows, blankets, etc.). We'll take care of complete preparation and subsequent cleaning.

bestTime.question: When is the best time for post-renovation cleaning?
bestTime.answer: Ideal is first rough cleaning after completion of construction work and then final cleaning just before handover. We can also perform regular cleanings during renovation.

constructionMaterials.question: Do you remove construction materials too?
constructionMaterials.answer: We remove construction dust, dirt and small debris. Large amounts of debris or materials must be cleared by the construction company beforehand.

cleaningDuration.question: How long does post-renovation cleaning take?
cleaningDuration.answer: For a 3+1 apartment, count on 6-10 hours depending on the degree of soiling. Larger spaces or very dirty surfaces can take several days.

exteriors.question: Do you clean exteriors, balconies too?
exteriors.answer: Yes, we offer complete service including window washing from outside, cleaning balconies, terraces and immediate surroundings.

luxuryMaterials.question: Do you have experience with luxury materials?
